title: Lean
info: One flow, one platform, custom design

features.text: Custom homepage & listing page design — brand colours, fonts, layout
One marketplace flow — product, rental, service, or booking
Custom listing fields for your vertical
Stripe Connect — commission structure configured to your model
Provider onboarding flow — custom signup steps and listing creation
Branded transactional emails — booking confirmed, payment received
SEO foundations — meta tags, sitemap, Open Graph, structured data
Web OR mobile app (one platform)
3 months free maintenance & support
No booking/availability logic
No AI features
Everything in Lean, plus:
All public pages custom designed — search, provider profile, category pages
2–3 marketplace flows — or reverse marketplace (buyers post, providers respond)
Booking & availability logic — time slots, buffer periods, cancellation rules
Advanced payments — deposits, refunds, split payouts, escrow release
Shipping (Shippo) OR calendar sync (Cronofy) — your choice
Advanced search with Algolia or Typesense — geo-search, faceted filters
Custom review & trust system — verified profiles, dispute workflow
Free digital marketing audit & plan
3 months free maintenance & support
No AI-powered features
No internal dashboard custom design

title: Pro
info: AI features, all pages, complex logic

features.text: Everything in Full, plus:
Full custom design — all internal pages including dashboards, admin panel
Web AND mobile app (both platforms)
AI features — listing generation, smart search, automated moderation
Multi-tier business models — subscriptions, memberships, tiered commissions
Complex transaction logic — milestone payments, multi-step approvals, escrow
Complex integrations — KYC, CRM sync, Voucherify, ERP connections
Scalable backend — caching, queues, performance under high volume
3 months free digital marketing execution
6 months free maintenance & support
